dct_description_sm:
Climate data used in this project was extracted from ClimateNA. 
Wang, T., A. Hamann, and Z. Sang. 2025. “Monthly High‐Resolution Historical Climate Data for North America Since 1901.” International Journal of Climatology 45(3): p.e8726. https://doi.org/10.1002/joc.8726

This dataset contains vegetation recovery, forest composition, tree recruitment, and tree-ring width data collected from burned and unburned plots in Nahanni National Park Reserve and Nááts’įhch’oh National Park Reserve, Northwest Territories, Canada, during the 2022 and 2023 field seasons. Detailed descriptions of data files, and variables are provided in ReadMe.docx. For more details of sampling methods and data analysis, please refer to Zhao et al., 2026. Resilience or reassembly: wildfire–vegetation dynamics in rapidly warming subarctic forests of northwestern Canada. Ecosphere.
